principle: Automation verifies evidence presence and repeatability; it does not replace strict professional review.

ZM0.name: Smoke / Reproducible Harness
ZM0.passRule: At least one completed durable run has complete trace; CI must be green separately.

ZM1.name: Single-Model Professional Baseline
ZM1.modelQualificationRule: A model needs at least three reviewed repeated runs on the same quest, no hard fail, and at least two PASS/STRONG_PASS verdicts.
ZM1.levelPassRule: At least two distinct real models meet the model qualification rule on the same professional quest.

ZM2.name: Critic Pair
ZM2.pairQualificationRule: For one exact quest, compare each reviewed Draft→Critic→Revision pair against reviewed single runs of its M1 draft/revision model. A pair qualifies when at least two reviewed relay runs have no hard fail, reviewer confirms dissentPreserved=true, and median strict score improves by at least 5 points over the M1 single baseline. Calls and latency/usage deltas must remain visible.
ZM2.levelPassRule: At least one critic pair demonstrates a reviewed professional quality gain over a qualified single-model baseline without hiding reviewer objections. This proves the critic pattern can add value for the bounded quest; it does not make the pair universally optimal.
